perQuery.note: Elicit surfaces both must-have landmarks (PARTNER 3 #1, Evolut 6-year #2) while Manan misses PARTNER 3 and buries Evolut at #6 amid meta-analyses and irrelevant entries.
Both rank DAPA-HF first with correct identifiers, but Manan adds a richer set of high-quality related trials and analyses beyond Elicit's thin commentary-heavy list.
Manan omits CLARITY-AD entirely and fills the top 10 with minor 2026 substudies, whereas Elicit leads with CLARITY-AD and adds meaningful follow-up evidence.
Manan includes cornerstone CVOT RCTs (EMPA-REG, CANVAS, DECLARE) alongside meta-analyses, while Elicit offers only older meta-analyses and no primary trial landmarks.
Manan includes the 2024 ESC AF guideline with full metadata, whereas Elicit tops out at 2016/2020 versions and omits the current document entirely.
Both miss pivotal DOAC RCTs (RE-LY, ROCKET-AF, ARISTOTLE, ENGAGE), but Manan leads with stronger network meta-analyses while Elicit ranks a NEJM Journal Watch summary first.

overall.summary: Manan wins four of six queries by excelling at exact-paper retrieval, guideline coverage, and PICO queries that benefit from primary CVOT trials. Elicit decisively wins landmark-heavy long-term outcome and recency queries where hierarchical ranking of must-have RCTs is critical. Neither system consistently surfaces all pivotal primary trials for therapy-comparison queries.
